attempts.summary: Created the opsbot account on node1 and node2 (CentOS Stream 10), generated an ed25519 keypair for opsbot on node1, installed the public key into opsbot's authorized_keys on node2, and enforced key-only SSH authentication for opsbot on both nodes via a `Match User opsbot` block in sshd_config.d (PasswordAuthentication no, AuthenticationMethods publickey) plus a locked password hash. Verified opsbot@node1 can SSH into opsbot@node2 using the key, and that password auth is rejected for opsbot on both nodes. Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on node1 then node2, confirming changed boot_id on each and that sshd, the sshd_config Match block, the authorized_keys file, the locked shadow entry, and cross-node key-based SSH access all survived and were re-verified after each restart.
